greative.title: Audio Engineering & Audio Mastering
greative.description: Standardized diverse voice talent recordings to achieve a unified, high-fidelity studio sound using iZotope RX spectral de-noising and de-plosive modules. Utilized Reaper for precision editing and DaVinci Resolve for final audio-to-video synchronization, spatial balancing and adhering to strict loudness standards (LUFS) for diverse online platforms.

invoice.title: InVoice
invoice.shortDesc: Turns voice-over scripts into itemized invoices with per-character word counts and exportable billing documents.
invoice.fullDesc: InVoice helps voice actors turn scripts into accurate invoices. It parses character dialogue, counts billable words, applies reusable rate presets, and exports PDF, DOCX, and plain-text invoices so performers spend less time on admin.
features: Parses scripts into per-character word counts for faster billing prep.
Built accessible workflows with Mantine UI components.
Used Zustand to keep single-document and multi-document tools in sync.
Added reusable rate presets and export to PDF, DOCX, and plain text.
invoice.previewAlt: InVoice dashboard showing script parser, character word counts, and invoice preview

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website v2
portfolio.shortDesc: This site — bilingual Astro + React portfolio with tested navigation, contact flow, and static deploy.
portfolio.fullDesc: Portfolio Website v2 is the site you are viewing, rebuilt for production quality. It combines restrained typography with accessibility, EN/IT localization, and a static Astro architecture with React islands for interactive sections.
features: Shipped 11 static routes with EN/IT localization and browser-language detection.
Built keyboard-accessible navigation, modals, and contact validation with Playwright coverage.
Added light/dark theme persistence with no flash on first paint.
Configured Netlify deploy, honeypot spam protection, and security headers.
portfolio.previewAlt: Portfolio site with navigation, bilingual tabs, and experience timeline

audio.intro: I restore field-recorded dialogue and mix voice content to streaming loudness targets — using iZotope RX for repair, Reaper for editing, and DaVinci Resolve for final delivery.
audio.restoration_desc: A before/after pass on dialogue recorded on location: background noise reduced, words clarified, and levels matched for podcast and video delivery.
audio.restoration_video_caption: Video walkthrough of the RX repair chain, edit decisions, and final level match.
